main.description: Put a document, and everything under it, in the bin. Its creator or an owner of its context may. Nothing is destroyed: restoreDocument brings back exactly what went together, and the path is free for another node meanwhile.

binned.description: How many nodes went to the bin.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such document, or none the caller may read.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller may read it but neither created it nor owns its context.
